note: The series RUMIN retrieves. This file defines what to fetch and how to describe it; it contains no data values. plausible_min/plausible_max are RUMIN's review thresholds (assumptions): values outside them are stored but flagged for review, never changed or dropped.

datasets.name: World Development Indicators
datasets.description: The World Bank's primary collection of development indicators, compiled from officially recognised international sources. RUMIN retrieves a small, curated selection of annual series for India, with the United States and the United Arab Emirates for context.
datasets.attribution: The World Bank: World Development Indicators. The original source of each series is named on the series.
datasets.update_frequency: Refreshed by the World Bank several times a year; any value may be revised in an update.
datasets.provenance_note: Retrieved by RUMIN from the World Bank Indicators API (v2) and stored exactly as published: values are not adjusted, converted, rounded or filled in. Each value records when it was retrieved and from which response, and every revision the World Bank makes is kept.

series.variable_relation: An annual counterpart of this variable, not the same measure: the World Bank series is the change in the annual average consumer price index, while the variable is defined as monthly year-on-year CPI inflation (MoSPI). Use it for long-run context, not as a monthly reading.
series.name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %) — India
series.description: Annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of a basket of goods and services.
series.aggregation: Annual average price level; percentage change over the previous year

series.variable_relation: An annual average of the official exchange rate, not the same measure: the variable is defined as a daily market rate. Annual averages smooth out movements within the year.
series.name: Official exchange rate (INR per US$, period average) — India
series.description: Exchange rate determined by national authorities or in the legally sanctioned exchange market, as an annual average.
series.aggregation: Annual average based on monthly averages

series.name: Lending interest rate (%) — India
series.description: The bank rate that usually meets the short- and medium-term financing needs of the private sector. Not the RBI policy repo rate.
series.aggregation: Annual value as published by the provider

series.name: Real interest rate (%) — India
series.description: The lending interest rate adjusted for inflation as measured by the GDP deflator.
series.aggregation: Annual value as published by the provider

series.name: GDP growth (annual %) — India
series.description: Annual percentage growth of gross domestic product at market prices, based on constant local currency.
series.aggregation: Change in annual GDP at constant prices over the previous year

series.name: GDP (current US$) — India
series.description: Gross domestic product in current US dollars, converted from rupees at single-year official exchange rates.

series.name: Current account balance (% of GDP) — India
series.description: The sum of net exports of goods and services, net primary income and net secondary income, as a share of GDP.
series.aggregation: Annual total as a share of annual GDP

series.name: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP) — India
series.description: The value of all goods and other market services provided to the rest of the world, as a share of GDP.
series.aggregation: Annual total as a share of annual GDP

series.name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %) — United States
series.description: Annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of a basket of goods and services.
series.aggregation: Annual average price level; percentage change over the previous year

series.name: GDP growth (annual %) — United States
series.description: Annual percentage growth of gross domestic product at market prices, based on constant local currency.
series.aggregation: Change in annual GDP at constant prices over the previous year

series.name: GDP growth (annual %) — United Arab Emirates
series.description: Annual percentage growth of gross domestic product at market prices, based on constant local currency.
series.aggregation: Change in annual GDP at constant prices over the previous year
